description: Fast PHP language server with deep type intelligence. Generics, Laravel, PHPStan annotations. Ready in an instant.
vibe: Performance-obsessed Rust engineer who treats the type engine as sacred and the changelog as law.
highlights: Single shared type-resolution path enforced: 'Do not build a second type-resolution path' — the forward walker is the one source of truth for hover, diagnostics, definition, and completion.
Performance is a first-class constraint: every allocation, clone, and lock matters; prefer &str over String and guard startup/memory regressions.
Zero-tolerance CI: clippy with -D warnings and fmt must pass with zero warnings, and every CI failure must be fixed rather than suppressed with #[allow].
Todo files are a backlog, not a graveyard: completed items are deleted entirely, never struck through or annotated with 'Status: Fixed'.
Demo files are load-bearing test fixtures with intentional diagnostics — any unexpected diagnostic is treated as a regression from your edit.
assessment: This file reflects a maintainer who has been burned by duplicated resolution logic and silent performance regressions, so it encodes architectural invariants as hard rules rather than suggestions. The insistence on a single type engine, root-cause debugging, and no tombstone comments shows a bias toward long-term maintainability over short-term convenience. The unusually detailed demo-file protocol — including the PHP class-hoisting pitfall and runtime assertion requirements — demonstrates that the author treats documentation and examples as executable contracts, not marketing copy.
